resources.string: Lets you enter text on the head unit into the focused text field of a DiLink 5 cluster cast app. Password fields are excluded. Enable automatic prompts only if you want the keyboard dialog to open when a cluster text field gains focus.
Automatically open for cluster text fields
Enable “OverDrive cluster text entry” in Accessibility settings, then focus a text field in the cast app and check again.
Cluster text entry requires DiLink 5 with Android 11 or newer and access to the cluster’s accessibility windows. This firmware cannot verify which display owns a text field.
Start a DiLink 5 app cast before entering text.
No accessible, focused text field was found on the cluster. Focus a field in the cast app and check again. Password fields are excluded.
The cast session or focused field changed. Check the field again before sending.
The cluster text field could not be verified. Check the cast and accessibility connection, then try again.
The app did not confirm the text. Check the cluster field before trying again.
Text was sent, but the app did not accept Enter. Submit from the cluster app.
